parsing_traps: STAPLED TRUST: financial statements present HBT Group / H-REIT Group / Stapled Group in three columns — the Stapled Group column is canonical and used throughout.

Statement of Total Return places Depreciation (S$22,576k), management/trustee/valuation/acquisition fees and other trust expenses BELOW Net Property Income; these are captured in operating_expense (not property opex). Property expenses (cost_of_revenue) 125,036 reconciles: revenue 260,259 − property expenses 125,036 = NPI 135,223.

Portfolio Statement splits properties into Investment Properties (14 line-items, Stapled Σ 2,478,796k) and Property, Plant & Equipment (9 hotels + Other plant & equipment, Stapled PPE Σ 846,454k → property rows Σ 845,001k). market_valuation taken from the audited Stapled Group Portfolio Statement '000 (p205-208). Per-property GR/NPI from 'Performance by Country and Property' (p28): 'Properties with Leases' use Gross Rental Revenue; 'Managed Properties' use Gross Hotel Revenue. Both feed gross_revenue; totals reconcile to 260,259 / 135,223.

net_property_sales = 0: no investment-property disposals in FY2024. The 'Gain from a bargain purchase' S$3,035k is an acquisition gain (not a property sale) and is kept in line_items as a signed adjustment.
